_comment: Released VISTA checkpoints. Fill in 'url' for each entry (Hugging Face / Zenodo / Google Drive / plain HTTPS). Paths are relative to the repository root. If a file is re-packed (e.g. optimizer state stripped), update sha256 and size.

mardm.description: Stage-2 VISTA MARDM (use key ema_mardm); used for sampling and evaluation

dae.description: DualAE with the decoder fine-tuned in Stage 2; evaluation / sampling

style_classifier.description: Kinematic style classifier (21 classes); style-feature loss and SRA

dae_stage1.description: Stage-1 DualAE (input to Stage-2 training only)
